zh: 车停下来时，引擎会自动熄火。
en: The engine {shuts off|switches off|turns off|cuts out|stops} automatically when you stop.

zh: 在下一个出口下高速。
en: {Turn off|Get off|Come off} the motorway at the next exit.

zh: 一辆皮卡突然插到我前面。
en: A ute {cut in|pulled in} right in front of me.

zh: 你看起来很累，要不要我来开一会儿？
en: You look tired. Do you want me to {take over} for a bit?

zh: 警察示意我靠边停车。
en: The police officer signalled me to {pull over|stop}.

zh: 我们把车装满了露营装备。
en: We {loaded up|packed|filled} the car with camping gear.

zh: 上车吧，我送你一程。
en: {Hop in|Get in|Jump in}, I'll give you a lift.

zh: 他以为在那儿违停能逃过处罚。
en: He thinks he can {get away with} parking there.

zh: 我用旧车折价换了一辆混合动力车。
en: I {traded in|part-exchanged} my old car for a hybrid.

zh: 有人半夜把我的轮胎气放了。
en: Someone {let down|deflated} my tyres overnight.

zh: 车在高速上突然熄火了。
en: The engine {cut out|died|stalled|conked out} on the motorway.

zh: 她轻轻松松就通过了驾照考试。
en: She {sailed through|breezed through|aced|passed} her driving test.

zh: 开了两个小时了，我们换人开吧。
en: We've been driving for two hours. Let's {swap over|swap|switch over|switch|change over}.

zh: 一辆车突然从车道上开出来，就在我前面。
en: A car {pulled out|came out|shot out} of a driveway right in front of me.

zh: 火车准时进站了。
en: The train {pulled in|came in|got in|arrived} right on time.

zh: 那只猫差点被车压到。
en: The cat was nearly {run over|hit} by a car.

zh: 他们应该恢复以前那条公交线路。
en: They should {bring back|restore|reinstate} the old bus route.

zh: 公交车一直没来，我们最后打了车。
en: The bus never came, so we {ended up|wound up|finished up} taking a taxi.

zh: 我已经约好周五把车送去保养了。
en: I've {booked in|booked} my car for a service on Friday.

zh: 车祸后我的车报废了。
en: My car was {written off|totalled|totaled} after the crash.

zh: 他倒车的时候撞到了一根柱子。
en: He {ran into|backed into|crashed into|drove into|hit} a pole while reversing.

zh: 车门一开，大家都挤了进去。
en: The doors opened and everyone {piled in|crowded in|squeezed in}.

zh: 回家的路上我们在Countdown停了一下。
en: We {stopped off|stopped|called in|popped in} at Countdown on the way home.

zh: 我还没坐下，公交车就开走了。
en: The bus {pulled away|pulled out|drove off|took off|left} before I'd even sat down.

zh: 慢点！这里限速五十。
en: {Slow down}! The speed limit is fifty here.

zh: 孩子们，系好安全带，我们要出发了。
en: {Buckle up|Belt up}, kids. We're leaving.

zh: 在左边第二条街拐进去。
en: {Turn into} the second street on the left.

zh: 我们在高速公路上爆胎了。
en: One of our tyres {blew out|burst|went|popped} on the motorway.

zh: 我那辆老车终于彻底坏了。
en: My old car finally {packed in|packed up|broke down|died|conked out|gave up}.

zh: 警察只给了他一个警告，没罚他。
en: He got {let off} with a warning from the police.

zh: 我们下了高速去吃午饭。
en: We {pulled off|got off|turned off|came off} the motorway to grab some lunch.

zh: 撞了我的车之后，对方司机直接开走了。
en: The other driver just {drove off|drove away|took off|left} after hitting my car.

zh: 我花了一个小时干等公交车。
en: I spent an hour {waiting around|hanging around|waiting} for the bus.

zh: 他在公交车上给一位老太太让了座。
en: He {gave up|offered} his seat to an elderly woman on the bus.

zh: 我们在路上经过了天空塔。
en: We {passed by|drove past|went past|passed} the Sky Tower on the way.

zh: 他过马路时被车撞倒了。
en: He was {knocked down|hit|run over|knocked over} by a car while crossing the road.

zh: 倒车出车道的时候要小心。
en: Be careful when {backing out|reversing out|reversing} of the driveway.

zh: 他超速了，结果只被警告了一下就没事了。
en: He was speeding but {got away with|got off with} just a warning.

zh: 抱歉我迟到了，路上堵车耽搁了。
en: Sorry I'm late, I was {held up|stuck|delayed|caught up} in traffic.

zh: 这些新公交车是用电的。
en: These new buses {run on|use} electricity.

zh: 小心！有车过来了！
en: {Look out|Watch out|Careful}! There's a car coming!

zh: 我的轮胎花纹已经磨平了。
en: The tread on my tyres has {worn down|worn away|worn}.

zh: 注意找去机场的出口。
en: {Look out for|Watch out for|Watch for|Keep an eye out for} the turn-off to the airport.

zh: 小心！有车过来了。
en: {Watch out|Look out|Be careful}! There's a car coming.

zh: 雾太大了，我看不清路标。
en: The fog was so thick I couldn't {make out|see|read} the road signs.

zh: 车祸后那条路被封了。
en: The road was {closed off|closed|blocked off|shut|cordoned off|sealed off} after the crash.

zh: 去机场的路上一定要把堵车的时间算进去。
en: Make sure you {allow for|factor in|plan for|account for} traffic on the way to the airport.

zh: 我们在布里托马特上了公交车。
en: We {got on|boarded|hopped on|caught} the bus at Britomart.

zh: 抓紧了，接下来的路会很颠簸。
en: {Hang on|Hold on} tight, the road gets bumpy from here.

zh: 车流一直堵到了大桥那边。
en: Traffic was {backed up} all the way to the bridge.

zh: 快点，我们要错过公交车了！
en: {Hurry up}, we're going to miss the bus!

zh: 前面那辆车突然加速了。
en: The car in front suddenly {sped up|accelerated}.
